igeek-ts0fne.description:
• Ink up the Splatlands in the next Splatoon game! 

• Enter the Splatlands, a sun-scorched desert inhabited by battle-hardened Inklings and Octolings. Splatsville, the city of chaos, is the adrenaline-fueled heart of this dusty wasteland. 

• Even in this desolate environment, Turf War* reigns supreme and battles rage in new stages located in the surrounding wilds, such as the majestic Scorch Gorge. 

• Dynamic new moves help these fighters dodge attacks and cover more ground, along with a new bow-shaped weapon to sling ink and new special weapons, such as the scuttling Crab Tank. 

• "Return of the Mammalians" - Take control of Agent 3 and fight against the evil Octarian army alongside the New Squidbeak Splatoon in Splatoon 3's story mode. Discover the secrets of Alterna, the Fuzzy Ooze and how it connects to the mode's theme, "Return of the Mammalians"..Salmon Run Next Wave - The Salmonid are back, and they've got some new surprises in store for the Inklings and Octolings in the co-op mode: Salmon Run Next Wave!.

igeek-9seo6j.description:
Set sail on an all-new adventure with the Mushroom Kingdom’s favorite duo in Mario and Luigi: Brothership ! In this exciting installment, Mario and Luigi team up to explore uncharted seas, solve puzzles, and save the day in their signature comedic style.

 
• 
 Embark on a Nautical Quest : Travel across a vibrant world filled with mysterious islands, hidden treasures, and perilous enemies.

• 
 Classic Mario & Luigi Gameplay : Engage in thrilling turn-based battles with dynamic, interactive mechanics that keep you on your toes.

• 
 Tag-Team Moves : Unlock powerful duo abilities to overcome obstacles, solve puzzles, and defeat enemies in creative ways.

• 
 New Characters & Enemies : Meet quirky allies and face off against a cast of hilarious new villains.

• 
 Family-Friendly Fun : Perfect for players of all ages, with easy-to-learn controls and charming humor.

 
 Gather your courage, strengthen your bond, and set sail with Mario and Luigi in their most daring adventure yet in Mario and Luigi: Brothership !

igeek-tysskh.description:
Step into the whimsical world of Paper Mario: The Thousand-Year Door for Nintendo Switch, where paper-thin heroes embark on an unforgettable adventure! This beloved RPG classic returns, bringing its unique blend of humor, charm, and engaging gameplay to a new generation of players.

 Join Mario on his quest to rescue Princess Peach and uncover the secrets of the mysterious Thousand-Year Door. Set in the vibrant and imaginative Rogueport, players will encounter a cast of quirky characters, each with their own stories and challenges. As you navigate this richly detailed world, solve clever puzzles, and engage in turn-based battles, you’ll discover a captivating narrative filled with unexpected twists and delightful surprises.

 Experience the innovative combat system that blends action commands with RPG mechanics. Time your button presses for powerful attacks and defensive maneuvers, and utilize a variety of partners, each with unique abilities, to tackle challenges and defeat enemies. The game’s distinct paper aesthetic adds a charming visual flair, transforming the ordinary into the extraordinary as you explore the richly designed environments.

 With its witty writing, engaging storyline, and strategic gameplay, Paper Mario: The Thousand-Year Door offers a nostalgic experience for fans of the series and a perfect introduction for newcomers. Rediscover the magic of this classic RPG, now optimized for the Nintendo Switch, and embark on a paper-thin adventure that will keep you entertained for hours.

 Prepare to unfold the adventure of a lifetime in Paper Mario: The Thousand-Year Door —where every turn is a new chapter waiting to be explored!

igeek-1bb25ci.description:
Get ready to kick off the ultimate showdown with Mario Strikers for Nintendo Switch! This exhilarating multiplayer sports game combines the beloved characters of the Mario franchise with fast-paced soccer action, creating a unique and entertaining experience for players of all ages.

 In Mario Strikers , you’ll step onto the field as your favorite Mario characters, each with their own special abilities and skills. Form your dream team and compete against friends or AI opponents in thrilling matches filled with over-the-top moves and outrageous power-ups. With simple yet engaging controls, players can easily master the mechanics while enjoying the chaotic fun that only Mario can deliver.

 The game features a variety of dynamic arenas, each with unique hazards and power-ups that can change the course of the match. Experience intense 5-on-5 matches where strategy, teamwork, and skill are essential for victory. Customize your characters and choose from various gear options to enhance their abilities and give your team the edge on the field.

 Whether you’re playing in local multiplayer or online mode, Mario Strikers promises endless hours of fun and competitive excitement. Gather your friends and family for a soccer showdown that blends Mario's charm with thrilling sports action!

 Get ready to score big and show off your skills in Mario Strikers —the ultimate fusion of teamwork and competition!

igeek-936u6s.description:
Join Kirby in a delightful and whimsical adventure with Kirby: Return to Dream Land for Nintendo Switch! This beloved platformer returns with vibrant graphics and engaging gameplay that captures the charm and magic of the iconic franchise.

 In Return to Dream Land , players are invited to explore the colorful world of Dream Land alongside Kirby and his friends—Meta Knight, King Dedede, and Waddle Dee. When an intergalactic traveler named Magolor crashes on Planet Popstar, it’s up to Kirby and his companions to help him recover his lost ship parts and restore peace to the realm.

 Experience the classic Kirby gameplay you love, enhanced with new features that elevate the action. Use Kirby’s signature copy ability to absorb enemies and gain their powers, opening up a world of creative possibilities in combat and puzzle-solving. The game also introduces cooperative multiplayer, allowing up to four players to team up and share in the fun, each with their own unique abilities.

 With beautifully designed levels, engaging boss battles, and hidden secrets to discover, Kirby: Return to Dream Land invites players of all ages to enjoy a charming adventure filled with humor and excitement.

 Whether you’re a longtime fan or new to the series, this title is sure to bring smiles and laughter as you embark on an unforgettable journey with Kirby. Get ready to inhale, float, and dash your way through the dream-filled landscapes of Planet Popstar!

igeek-13culo9.description:
Dive into a mesmerizing adventure with The Legend of Zelda: Echoes of Wisdom for Nintendo Switch, the latest installment in the beloved Zelda franchise. Set in a breathtakingly expansive world, this title invites players to explore the rich lore and vibrant landscapes of Hyrule like never before.

 In this new chapter, players join Link and Princess Zelda as they embark on a quest to uncover ancient secrets and restore harmony to the realm. As darkness threatens to engulf Hyrule, you must harness the power of wisdom, courage, and determination to face formidable foes and solve intricate puzzles. With an innovative gameplay system that blends classic mechanics with fresh features, Echoes of Wisdom redefines what it means to be a hero in the Zelda universe.

 Explore lush forests, treacherous mountains, and mysterious ruins, all while encountering a diverse cast of characters, each with their own stories to tell. The game introduces new abilities and weapons that allow for creative problem-solving and dynamic combat. Harness the power of Echoes—mystical fragments that enhance your skills and provide unique gameplay mechanics, allowing you to manipulate the environment and influence your surroundings.

 With stunning visuals and an enchanting soundtrack that pays homage to the franchise’s legacy, The Legend of Zelda: Echoes of Wisdom promises an unforgettable experience for both newcomers and longtime fans.

 Join Link on this epic quest, and discover the echoes of wisdom that lie hidden throughout Hyrule. Your adventure awaits!

igeek-1625gv6.description:
Embark on an extraordinary journey through the ancient Sinnoh region in Pokémon Legends: Arceus for Nintendo Switch, where past meets future in a bold new open-world adventure. This groundbreaking entry in the Pokémon series offers a fresh take on Pokémon exploration and battling, blending classic gameplay elements with new mechanics and a more immersive world.

 Set in a time long before the events of modern Pokémon games, Pokémon Legends: Arceus allows you to explore the vast, untamed wilderness of the Sinnoh region, where Pokémon roam freely. As part of the Galaxy Expedition Team, your mission is to explore, survey, and create the first Pokédex of the region, discovering wild Pokémon in their natural habitats and engaging in innovative real-time battle mechanics.

 Featuring seamless transitions between exploration and combat, Pokémon Legends: Arceus introduces new catching techniques and strategic battle systems that allow you to approach Pokémon in different ways. Stealth, strategy, and action come together as you navigate the world, set traps, or engage Pokémon directly in dynamic encounters.

 With rich environments, an immersive storyline, and new forms of beloved Pokémon, including Hisuian variants, Pokémon Legends: Arceus offers a nostalgic yet innovative experience for both longtime fans and newcomers. Discover the origins of the Pokémon universe and the legendary Pokémon Arceus as you uncover the mysteries of the Sinnoh region.

 Experience a world of wonder, discovery, and adventure in Pokémon Legends: Arceus on Nintendo Switch. This is a Pokémon adventure unlike any you’ve experienced before!

igeek-lix6c9.description:
Step into the power suit of intergalactic bounty hunter Samus Aran in Metroid Prime for Nintendo Switch, an iconic first-person adventure that redefined the action-adventure genre. Originally released for the GameCube, this critically acclaimed classic returns with enhanced visuals and controls, optimized for the Nintendo Switch, offering a fresh experience to both veteran fans and new players alike.

 Explore the mysterious alien world of Tallon IV, a richly detailed and immersive environment filled with secrets, ancient ruins, hostile creatures, and a labyrinth of interconnected biomes. Armed with a variety of high-tech weapons and abilities, you’ll uncover the dark history of the Chozo civilization and unravel the sinister plot of the Space Pirates.

 Seamlessly blending first-person action with exploration and puzzle-solving, Metroid Prime immerses you in an atmospheric world where you must rely on quick reflexes, sharp thinking, and upgrades like the Morph Ball, Grapple Beam, and various visors to uncover hidden areas and defeat powerful bosses. The non-linear structure allows for deep exploration, with hidden paths and upgrades rewarding players who take the time to delve into every corner of the map.

 The Nintendo Switch version introduces updated motion controls, alongside traditional control schemes, providing flexible gameplay options that feel intuitive and immersive. Whether you’re playing docked on the big screen or on the go, Metroid Prime for Switch brings this legendary game to a new generation of gamers.

 Prepare to embark on an epic journey to uncover the mysteries of Tallon IV and battle against a deadly alien threat. Metroid Prime on Nintendo Switch delivers the definitive version of this timeless classic, combining exploration, combat, and puzzle-solving in one of the greatest adventures of all time.

igeek-19nmgwm.description:
Experience the epic saga of Dragon Ball Z like never before with Dragon Ball Z: Kakarot for PlayStation 5. Immerse yourself in a beautifully recreated world that brings the beloved anime series to life, allowing you to relive the iconic battles and story arcs of Goku and his friends as they defend Earth against powerful foes.

 Dragon Ball Z: Kakarot invites players to explore the vast landscapes of the Dragon Ball universe, from the serene forests of West City to the intense battles on Planet Namek. With enhanced graphics and performance on PS5, enjoy breathtaking visuals and smooth frame rates that elevate your gaming experience to new heights.

 Engage in exhilarating combat that combines RPG elements with fast-paced action. Utilize Goku’s extensive arsenal of moves and abilities, including powerful transformations and signature attacks like the Kamehameha. Players can also unlock and train additional characters, each with unique skills, to create the ultimate team for battle against formidable enemies such as Frieza, Cell, and Majin Buu.

 Beyond combat, Dragon Ball Z: Kakarot offers a rich narrative experience, allowing players to dive deep into character development and side quests that expand the story. Relive memorable moments from the series, interact with iconic characters, and uncover hidden secrets as you progress through the game.

 The PS5 version enhances gameplay with faster load times and improved graphics, making it the definitive way to experience Goku's journey. Whether you’re a long-time fan or new to the franchise, Dragon Ball Z: Kakarot delivers a captivating adventure filled with nostalgia, excitement, and immersive gameplay.

 Are you ready to unleash your power and save the world in Dragon Ball Z: Kakarot for PlayStation 5? Join Goku and his friends on an unforgettable adventure today!

igeek-5ic2s2.description:
Experience the legendary saga of stealth and strategy with the Metal Gear Solid: Master Collection for PlayStation 5. This definitive collection brings together the iconic titles of the groundbreaking franchise, allowing both newcomers and longtime fans to dive into the rich narrative and innovative gameplay that has defined a generation of gaming.

 The Master Collection features the critically acclaimed Metal Gear Solid games, remastered for the PS5 with stunning visuals and enhanced performance. Explore the intricate stories, complex characters, and immersive environments that have made Metal Gear Solid a landmark series in gaming history.

 Engage in strategic stealth gameplay, utilizing a variety of tactics and gadgets to navigate challenging missions. From the intense espionage of the original Metal Gear Solid to the refined mechanics of its sequels, each title offers unique challenges and unforgettable moments.

 In addition to the core games, the collection includes bonus content such as behind-the-scenes features, concept art, and remastered audio, providing fans with a comprehensive experience that celebrates the legacy of the series.

 With the power of the PS5, Metal Gear Solid: Master Collection delivers enhanced graphics, faster load times, and improved gameplay mechanics, ensuring a seamless and engaging experience. Immerse yourself in the world of tactical espionage and uncover the mysteries that lie within.

 Join Solid Snake and other iconic characters on an unforgettable journey through the Metal Gear Solid universe. Whether you're revisiting these classics or experiencing them for the first time, the Master Collection is an essential addition to any gaming library.

igeek-rujehv.description:
Prepare for battle in Tekken 8 Launch Edition for PlayStation 5, the latest installment in the legendary fighting game franchise that has captivated fans for decades. Featuring cutting-edge graphics, refined gameplay mechanics, and an expanded roster of iconic characters, Tekken 8 raises the bar for competitive fighting games.

 Experience breathtaking visuals powered by the PS5, bringing every character and arena to life with stunning detail. The game introduces new combat mechanics that enhance strategic depth and fluidity, allowing players to execute powerful combos and devastating moves with precision. Whether you're a seasoned fighter or a newcomer to the series, the intuitive controls make it easy to jump into the action.

 Tekken 8 features an impressive lineup of both returning favorites and new challengers, each with unique fighting styles and signature abilities. Engage in thrilling one-on-one battles across a variety of beautifully designed stages, each with its own interactive elements that can turn the tide of a match.

 The game also includes an expansive single-player campaign, where players can explore the rich lore of the Tekken universe, along with robust multiplayer modes that allow you to compete against friends locally or challenge players worldwide online.

 With the Launch Edition, players can enjoy exclusive bonuses, including early access to additional characters, costumes, and other in-game content that enhance your fighting experience.

 Get ready to unleash your skills and showcase your dominance in Tekken 8 Launch Edition , where every match is a test of strategy, timing, and skill. Join the fight and become part of the legacy in this iconic series!

igeek-1yeboew.description:
Step into the fast lane with F1 2023 for PlayStation 5, the most immersive and realistic Formula 1 racing experience to date. Building on the thrilling foundation of its predecessors, this game features all the official teams, drivers, and circuits from the exhilarating 2023 FIA Formula One World Championship.

 With stunning visuals powered by the capabilities of the PS5, F1 2023 brings every race to life with lifelike graphics, realistic physics, and dynamic weather effects. Feel the adrenaline as you navigate famous tracks, including iconic circuits and new additions to the calendar, all meticulously recreated for an authentic racing experience.

 The revamped Career Mode allows you to create and manage your own F1 team, make critical strategic decisions, and develop your driver’s career path. Experience the new Braking Point 2 story mode, where you’ll face rivalries, personal challenges, and the pressure of high-stakes racing, offering a cinematic narrative that immerses you in the world of F1.

 With advanced handling mechanics and enhanced AI, F1 2023 ensures a competitive and engaging racing experience, whether you're a newcomer or a seasoned veteran. The game also features a robust multiplayer mode, enabling you to challenge friends and players around the world in exhilarating races.

 Experience the thrill of F1 racing like never before in F1 2023 , where precision, speed, and strategy collide on the track. Get ready to race for glory and prove your skills as you aim for the championship!

igeek-s33k25.description:
Get ready to dance like never before with Just Dance 2024 for PlayStation 5, the ultimate party game that brings friends and family together for hours of fun! With an expansive library of the latest chart-topping hits and classic favorites, this installment of the beloved franchise invites players of all ages to show off their dance moves and enjoy a vibrant, interactive experience.

 Featuring a user-friendly interface and improved motion tracking capabilities powered by the PS5, Just Dance 2024 allows players to effortlessly follow on-screen choreography while immersing themselves in stunning graphics and colorful animations. Whether you're a seasoned dancer or just looking to have a good time, the game offers a variety of dance styles and routines that cater to every skill level.

 This year, Just Dance 2024 introduces new online and multiplayer modes, enabling you to challenge friends or join global dance-offs. With regular updates and seasonal content, there’s always something new to discover, keeping the experience fresh and exciting.

 Additionally, the game features the all-new Just Dance+ subscription service, offering access to an even larger catalog of songs and exclusive content, ensuring that the dance party never stops!

 Whether you’re dancing solo, with friends, or competing against players around the world, Just Dance 2024 delivers an energetic and engaging experience that celebrates the joy of movement and music. Grab your controller, hit the dance floor, and get ready to groove!

igeek-xoercb.description:
Embark on a thrilling adventure in the vibrant world of One Piece with One Piece Odyssey for PlayStation 5. This captivating RPG transports you into the beloved universe of Luffy and his crew as they set sail for new horizons and face unprecedented challenges on their quest for treasure and adventure.

 In One Piece Odyssey , players will experience an original storyline crafted in collaboration with the legendary creator Eiichiro Oda. Join Luffy, Zoro, Nami, and the rest of the Straw Hat Pirates as they explore mysterious islands, engage in dynamic turn-based battles, and interact with iconic characters from the series. With beautifully rendered graphics powered by the PS5, the game brings the rich art style of One Piece to life in stunning detail.

 Utilize each character’s unique abilities in combat and solve intricate puzzles throughout the expansive world. The game’s strategic gameplay encourages players to switch between characters, exploiting their strengths to overcome formidable foes and obstacles.

 Whether you’re a lifelong fan of the series or new to the One Piece universe, One Piece Odyssey offers an immersive and engaging RPG experience filled with heart, humor, and the spirit of adventure. Set sail and create your own story in this unforgettable journey!

igeek-xgy43s.description:
Dive into the exhilarating world of Jujutsu Kaisen with Cursed Clash for PlayStation 5, the ultimate 2v2 arena fighting game based on the hit anime and manga series. Relive iconic battles and experience the high-octane action as you play as your favorite characters like Yuji Itadori, Megumi Fushiguro, and Satoru Gojo.

 In Cursed Clash , players can master unique cursed techniques and chain powerful combos to defeat opponents in fast-paced, visually stunning battles. The PS5's advanced hardware brings the game's vibrant anime-inspired graphics to life with smooth 60fps performance and stunning particle effects that enhance every cursed technique and special attack.

 Whether you're teaming up with friends or facing off against AI foes, Jujutsu Kaisen Cursed Clash delivers an action-packed experience for fans of the series and fighting game enthusiasts alike. Build your ideal team, unleash devastating abilities, and immerse yourself in the world of Jujutsu sorcery, all while rising through the ranks to become the ultimate jujutsu sorcerer.

igeek-168hc8u.description:
Game Features

 
 
 
 
 
 
 

 5v5 Rush

 Team up in 5v5 Rush, a new way to play with friends in Football Ultimate Team™, Clubs, and Kick-Off with fast-paced small-sided gameplay.

 
 
 
 
 
 

 FC IQ

 An overhaul of tactical foundations across the game delivers greater strategic control and more realistic collective movement at the team level. FC IQ also utilises a new AI model, powered by real-world data, to influence player tactics through all-new Player Roles.

 
 
 
 
 
 

 Football Ultimate Team

 Select your favourite Player Item and team up with friends in 5v5 Rush matches. Switch up your style of play with the click of a button by employing Manager Items, and find the perfect synergies between your Player Items based on specific Player Roles.

 
 
 
 
 
 

 Manager & Player Career

 Live out the biggest storylines from the real-world with Live Start Points** (arriving as a post-launch update); rewrite the stories of past ICONs with today’s teams in Player Career; and play an authentic Women’s Career experience using a club or player from the top five women’s leagues. **To be released with a post-launch update. For more details & availability, visit ea.com/games/ea-sports-fc/fc-25/disclaimers.

 
 
 
 
 
 

 Clubs

 Play, win, and progress with friends in more ways than ever before. Connect with club mates in your new Clubhouse and see friends’ avatars when they enter the mode. Take your club to new heights with Facilities, and showcase your skills in Clubs Rush.

 
 
 
 
 
 

 Unrivalled Authenticity

 Experience unrivalled authenticity in EA SPORTS FC™ 25 with the most true-to-life experience of football’s biggest competitions, clubs and stars, with 19,000+ players across 700+ teams in more than 120 stadiums and over 30 leagues. EA SPORTS FC™ 25 is the only place you can play the iconic UEFA Champions League, UEFA Europa League, UEFA Europa Conference League, CONMEBOL Libertadores, Premier League, Bundesliga, and LALIGA EA SPORTS, all in the same game, plus the UEFA Women's Champions League, Barclays Women's Super League, the National Women's Soccer League, the D1 Arkema, Liga F and the Google Pixel Frauen-Bundesliga.

igeek-122t0ah.description:
Features

 
 
 
 
• Jump and climb your way through over 130 puzzling levels as Mario to retrieve the Mini-Marios stolen by Donkey Kong

• 
 Overcome obstacles like spikes, lava, and falling bricks to make it to the end of each level

• 
 Revisit the original challenge in Classic Style, or try Casual Style for a more relaxed experience

• 
 Play through two new worlds, featuring new environments, enemies, and game mechanics

• 
 Join the action as Toad and work together in the newly-added co-op mode

• 
 Enjoy updated visuals, music, and content in this enhanced version of the original Game BoyTM Advance game

 

 Product Description

 
 
 Donkey Kong has stolen the Mini-Marios! Solve platforming puzzles to get them back. Run, jump, and backflip your way to rescuing the stolen Mini-Mario toys in this puzzling twist on Mario action. Obstacles like spikes, moving platforms, and falling bricks stand in your way—put your brain to work and figure out the best way to reach the Mini-Marios! You’ll have to master Color Switches, Warp Boxes, and more as the difficulty ramps up across more than 130 levels, including challenging Plus and Expert levels.

 
 Tailor the challenge to your playstyle or bring a friend along in local multiplayer! 

 

 

 Seeking a laid-back experience? The newly-added Casual Style removes time limits and adds checkpoints so you can relax and think. Looking for a tough puzzle-platforming challenge? Classic Style has got you covered with the timed levels and one-hit defeats of the original Game Boy™ Advance game. But that’s not all—you can bring a friend along in the newly-added Two-Player Mode, which adds an extra objective for Mario and Toad to take on together!

igeek-1fsv82t.description:
Spider-Men, Peter Parker and Miles Morales, return for an exciting new adventure in the critically acclaimed Marvel’s Spider-Man franchise. Swing, jump, and utilize the new Web Wings to travel across Marvel’s New York, quickly switching between Peter Parker and Miles Morales to experience different stories and epic new powers, as the iconic villain Venom threatens to destroy their lives, their city, and the ones they love. 

 An evolution of the Spider-Man story The incredible power of the symbiote forces Peter and Miles to face the ultimate test of strength, both inside and outside the mask, as they balance their lives, friendships, and their duty to protect those in need. 

 Experience two playable Spider-Men Quickly swap between both Spider-Men as you explore an expanded Marvel’s New York. Experience Peter’s new symbiote abilities and Miles’ explosive bio-electric venom powers, and discover upgradeable, high-tech equipment that enhances the combat experience for extensive gameplay depth and variety. 

 Battle iconic Marvel Super Villains Fight against a variety of new and iconic villains, including an original take on the monstrous Venom, the ruthless Kraven the Hunter, the volatile Lizard, and many more! 

 Visit an expanded Marvel’s New York Explore a larger Marvel’s New York than ever before, featuring two new boroughs – Brooklyn and Queens – as well as locations like Coney Island.

• Explore a vibrant Hawaiian open world. The Crew Motorfest has settled down in one of the most breathtaking places on Earth: the island of O’ahu, Hawaii. Join high-speed street races through the bustling city of Honolulu, test your skills off-road on the ashy slopes of a volcano, or master the perfect curve on the tracks

The witch is back and more powerful than ever!

 
 

 
 Bayonetta struts through multiple locations in an all-new, over-the-top climax action game.

 
 
 
 

 
 Sporting a wicked new ensemble and somehow familiar pigtails, the titular Umbra Witch must face a mysterious evil using her signature guns and time-slowing Witch Time ability. This time, invading manmade bioweapons called Homunculi find themselves in Bayonetta’s crosshairs.

 
 
 
 
 

 

 
 Tap into Bayonetta’s naughtier side with Demon Masquerade, a new ability that channels the demon linked to her weapon allowing for some exciting action options, not to mention some hair-raising combos.

 
 

 

 
 Summon demonic darlings like Gomorrah, Malphas, and Phantasmaraneae during battle, unleashing their demonic powers in the heat of combat and in new, larger-than life battles where you directly control the action.

 
 
 A bounty of Bayonettas

igeek-1fys7jb.description:
• Take control of the powerful pink puffball, Kirby, and move around in 3D stages as you discover a mysterious world. What journey awaits Kirby? Take a deep breath and get ready for an unforgettable adventure! 

• Discover a mysterious world with abandoned structures from a past civilization—like a shopping mall?!

igeek-oulyj0.description:
• Get a special assortment of Poké Balls to start off your adventure in Pokémon Brilliant Diamond and Pokémon Shining Pearl 

• Journey to the Sinnoh region in Pokémon Brilliant Diamond and Pokémon Shining Pearl! 

• Embark on an adventure through the Sinnoh region with Pokémon Brilliant Diamond and Pokémon Shining Pearl on Nintendo Switch, coming on 19th November, 2021!

Rich in nature and with towering Mount Coronet at its heart, Sinnoh is a land of many myths passed down through the ages. • CREATIVE & BRUTAL COMBAT - Take advantage of your parkour skills to tip the scales of even the most brutal encounter. Clever thinking, traps and creative weapons will be your best friends

igeek-9lmhl4.description:
• Tee off in Mario Golf: Super Rush, the latest instalment of the Mario Golf series, coming to Nintendo Switch. Join your favourite Mushroom Kingdom characters on the fairway on courses filled with lush, natural scenery. 

• Get into the swing of things with button controls or use motion controls by holding the Joy-Con controller like a golf club. Just like the real thing, you’ll need to study the wind and terrain, but there are also handy features to help you ace your shots. Take advantage of a shot gauge that shows you how your shot will curve due to slopes, and a scan that lets you examine a course’s terrain. 

• Among the game’s new features is Speed Golf. In this mode, everyone tees off at the same time, then you’ll race through the course to reach your ball. Give it another whack to get it closer to the hole, then keep going! Outpace your opponents to come out on top. Your golfing skills aren’t the only things at play: make use of dashes and special shots to beat the competition. 

• Take a Mii character from rookie to pro golfer by teeing off against various Mushroom Kingdom characters in Story Mode. Level up with experience points earned during matches, then allocate these points to different stats to develop your character. 

• You can also enjoy multiplayer with up to three other players, both locally and online.

igeek-1uimc27.description:
• The American dream - play as the president of the United States in a Wild story that spans countries, time, and space. It's up to you to free the world, now for the first time on Nintendo Switch. 

• Super hero-in-chief - leap over buildings. Kill people with your mind. Run through tanks. Those are just some of the powers on offer that you can Wield in your quest. 

• Alien toys of destruction - Wield an impressive array of alien vehicles and weapons. The inflato-ray, the polarizer, the disintegrator, and many more are all are yours to utilize. 

• Dynamic DUO - seamless drop-in, drop-out co-op, a Saints row standard, improved. The only thing better than One malicious super-powered president is two! 

• Saints row IV re-selected contains an impressive 25 DLC packs, including the Dubstep gun (remix) Pack, The presidential Pack, The commander-in-chief Pack, and two episodic story expansions: enter the dominatrix and how the Saints save christmas. 

 

 
 
 
 
 
 From the manufacturer

 
 
 

 
 
 
 
 
 

 
 Saints Row IV - Nintendo Switch

 Description: 

 You are the President of the United States of America, and you must save all of us on Earth. 

 The Boss of the Saints has been elected to the Presidency of the United States but the Saints are just getting started. 

 After a catastrophic alien invasion of Earth, led by the evil Overlord Zinyak, the Saints have been transported the Saints to a bizarro-Steelport simulation. With homies new and old at their side, and an arsenal of superpowers and strange weapons, they must fight to free humanity from alien granddaddy Zinyak’s mental grasp. 

 The Saints have gone from the crackhouse to the Penthouse, to The White House – but now it’s up to you to free the world from Zinyak and his alien empire, saving the world in the wildest open world game ever, playable for the first time on Nintendo Switch.

igeek-1sqaax8.description:
• New stages and fighters are joined by the combined rosters of every past Super Smash Bros. Game 

• Challenge others anytime, anywhere, whether you're on the couch or on the go 

• Play any way you want—locally, online, in TV mode, Tabletop mode, Handheld mode, or even with GameCube Controllers 

• Fight faster and smarter with new and returning techniques, like the perfect shield and directional air dodge 

• Face off in 2-4 player battles, or play against the computer

igeek-m1zlyg.description:
• Campaign mode will take you on a globe-trotting adventure to sprawling sandbox locations and will deliver a dramatic conclusion to the world of assassination Trilogy. 

• Elusive targets are the ultimate HITMAN challenge and are Designed to offer an exciting, pulse-pounding experience. You need to track down a unique target, with little-to-no help from the HUD or Instinct and hatch a plan to eliminate them on the fly. 

• Expect your gameplay skills to be pushed to the Max in Escalation Contracts, as new elements are thrown at you in each stage of the contract. Disguise restrictions, added security cameras and other kinds of other complications will be thrown your way. 

• Play HITMAN 3 in VR with a new first-person perspective and truly immerse yourself in the world of assassination (requires PSVR headset)

igeek-mk4o5u.description:

• Players with save data from the Legend of Zelda: Breath of the Wild game will receive the Training Sword in-game bonus weapon 

• Experience the events of the Great Calamity 100 years before the Legend of Zelda: Breath of the Wild game 

• Play as characters like Link, Zelda and more and learn their distinct attacks and combat styles 

• See a lively Hyrule before it was ravaged by Calamity Ganon 

• 
 
 
 
 

 

 
 
 See Hyrule 100 years before the Legend of Zelda: Breath of the Wild game

 
 
 Join the struggle that brought Hyrule to its knees

 
 

 
 Learn more about Zelda, the four Champions, the King of Hyrule and more through dramatic cutscenes as they try to save the kingdom from Calamity. The Hyrule Warriors: Age of Calamity game is the only way to firsthand see what happened 100 years ago. 

 
 
 Experience Hyrule before the Great Calamity 

 
 

 
 See a lively Hyrule before it was ravaged by Ganon. 

 
 
 Battle hordes of Hyrule’s most formidable foes

 
 

 
 From barbaric Bokoblins to towering Lynels, Ganon’s troops have emerged in droves. Playable heroes like Link, Zelda and more must use their distinct abilities to carve through hundreds of enemies to save Hyrule from the impending Calamity. 

 
 
 Cut through enemy hordes using distinct abilities

 Fight against Calamity as your favorite characters

 
 

 
 Play as characters like Link, Zelda and more and discover their individual fighting styles and abilities.

 Conquer the battlefield with this Valkyria Chronicles for Nintendo Switch. igeek-ras415.description:
Product description

 The Pokémon Sword and Pokémon Shield games take place in the Galar region. Galar is an expansive region with diverse environments— an idyllic countryside, contemporary cities, thick forest, and craggy, snow-covered mountains. The people and the Pokémon who live there work together closely to develop the industries in the region. Fans will have the opportunity to visit various Gyms in the Galar region in their quest to become Champion. They will not be alone, since the newly discovered Pokémon they choose to be their first partner will be by their side.

 The adventure begins in Pokémon Sword and Pokémon Shield when players choose one of three new Pokémon—Grookey, Scorbunny, or Sobble. Grookey, a Grass-type Chimp Pokémon, is mischievous and full of boundless curiosity. Bursting with energy, Scorbunny, a Fire-type Rabbit Pokémon, is always running about. The stealthy Sobble, a Water-type Water Lizard Pokémon, shoots out attacks as it hides itself in water.
