gameon-chlej9.description:
Play as the Suicide Squad to take down the World’s Greatest DC Super Heroes, The Justice League.

 
 
 
 
 Suicide Squad: Kill the Justice League, is a genre-defying, action-adventure third-person shooter from Rocksteady Studios, creators of the critically acclaimed Batman: Arkham series.

 Featuring an original narrative set within an expansive open-world city of Metropolis, Suicide Squad: Kill the Justice League puts the four DC Super-Villains on a collision course with an invading alien force and DC Super Heroes who are now laser-focused on destroying the city they once vowed to protect. All the while, the Suicide Squad must be mindful of the lethal explosives implanted in their heads that could go off at the first sign of defiance.

 Each squad member has their own unique moveset with enhanced traversal abilities to freely explore the dynamic open-world of Metropolis, along with a variety of weapons to customize, and skills to master.

 Take down The Justice League yourself in single-player or team up with friends in multiplayer co-op.

 Don't be a hero.

 

 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 Watch the Suicide Squad Insider series

 Suicide Squad: Kill the Justice League features and gameplay

 From developer Rocksteady, this deep-dive series gives you the inside scoop on how Suicide Squad: Kill the Justice League was brought to life.

 
 
 

 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 

 

 
 
 
 Episode 01: Story and gameplay

 Find out how Rocksteady has combined combat systems, story, traversal abilities, melee attacks and explosive gunplay for a unique and exciting experience.

 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 

 

 
 
 
 Episode 02: Meet the Support Squad

 Learn more about the supporting cast and how they provide the Suicide Squad with weapons and tools to stand a fighting chance against the corrupted Justice League.

 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 

 

 
 
 
 Episode 03: Introducing Elseworlds

 You've played the main story campaign, now get the low-down on free post-launch content that will expand and evolve the game over time.

 

 
 
 
 
 
 

 
 
 
 
 

 The 'heroes'

 Meet Amanda Waller's rag-tag crew of government-hired killers who make up Task Force X

 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 

 

 
 
 Harley Quinn

 Since the events of Arkham City – and the death of Joker – the world has passed Dr. Harleen Quinzel (AKA Harley Quinn) by. A one-time sidekick and born survivor determined to be a one-woman show, Harley will now be forced to join a team of fellow misfits in order to do the impossible: Kill the Justice League.

 Swing into an epic brick-built adventure with LEGO Batman: Legacy of the Dark Knight, the ultimate LEGO Batman experience crafted exclusively for the PlayStation 5 that celebrates decades of Batman's legendary legacy across comics, film, and animation in one monumental, humor-filled, and action-packed journey. Combining the irresistible charm and wit of the beloved LEGO game formula with the rich, expansive mythology of the Dark Knight, Legacy of the Dark Knight delivers a fresh, imaginative, and deeply entertaining experience that is as rewarding for lifelong Batman fans as it is welcoming for players discovering the Caped Crusader for the very first time.

 Set across a vast, gorgeously realized brick-built Gotham City that serves as a living, breathing open world to explore, the game invites players to step into the cape and cowl of Batman across multiple story arcs that draw inspiration from the most iconic chapters in Batman's history. From the gritty streets of classic comic storylines to the cinematic drama of beloved film adaptations and the animated adventures that defined generations of fans, Legacy of the Dark Knight weaves these threads into a single cohesive and endlessly entertaining narrative tapestry.

Microsoft Flight Simulator 2024 Standard Edition — PS5 

 Take to the skies in the most breathtaking, immersive, and technically ambitious flight simulation experience ever brought to a console platform with Microsoft Flight Simulator 2024, now available in its Standard Edition for the PlayStation 5. Representing the pinnacle of flight simulation technology, this landmark title invites aviation enthusiasts, casual explorers, and dedicated sim pilots alike to experience the awe-inspiring freedom of flight across a stunningly recreated, true-to-life representation of the entire planet Earth, powered by the formidable hardware capabilities of the PS5.

 Built on an entirely new simulation engine that pushes the boundaries of what is technically possible on console hardware, Microsoft Flight Simulator 2024 introduces a new generation of environmental realism, aircraft fidelity, and dynamic world simulation that sets it apart from every flight experience that has come before it. Real-world meteorological data feeds live weather conditions into the simulation in real time, meaning the skies you fly through accurately reflect actual global weather patterns at the moment you play, from clear blue horizons and gentle thermals to fierce storms, turbulence, and dynamic cloud formations that challenge even the most experienced virtual pilots.

 The game features an expanded roster of meticulously recreated aircraft spanning commercial airliners, private jets, propeller-driven light aircraft, military jets, helicopters, gliders, and next-generation experimental aircraft, each modeled with extraordinary attention to aerodynamic accuracy, cockpit instrumentation, and authentic systems behavior. Whether you prefer the raw power of a supersonic fighter, the graceful simplicity of a single-engine Cessna, or the complexity of a fully featured commercial airliner, the 2024 edition has an aircraft that perfectly matches your flying ambitions.

 The entire planet serves as your playground, with photogrammetry-based terrain reconstruction and satellite imagery delivering a visually faithful recreation of Earth's landscapes, cities, coastlines, mountains, and natural wonders at a level of detail that continues to astound with every flight. Major airports worldwide are recreated with extraordinary precision, featuring accurate taxiways, terminal buildings, and ground traffic that bring the full aviation experience to life from pushback to touchdown.

 A comprehensive career mode introduces structured progression through a wide range of aviation disciplines including bush flying, aerobatics, commercial operations, search and rescue missions, and aerial firefighting, providing hours of purposeful, rewarding gameplay beyond free-flight exploration. The Standard Edition delivers the complete base game experience with its full aircraft roster, global terrain, career mode, and live world features, providing an outstanding entry point into the most complete flight simulation ever available on PlayStation.

 An extraordinary achievement in simulation gaming that delivers the timeless wonder of human flight to every PlayStation 5 owner who has ever looked up at the sky and imagined what it would feel like to soar.

Requiem for the dead. Nightmare for the living.

igeek-um7qxy.description:
• The award-winning FINAL FANTASY VII REMAKE INTERGRADE* retells the original story up to the escape from Midgar, with breathtaking visuals, fast-paced gameplay, and additional story elements. This RPG delivers unforgettable characters, a powerful narrative, and a hybrid battle system that blends real-time action with strategic, command-based combat. It also includes FF7R EPISODE INTERmission, a side story starring Yuffie Kisaragi that offers a fresh perspective running in parallel to Cloud’s journey. 

• STUNNING VISUALS - Explore Midgar like never before with stunning visuals and richly detailed environments that bring the city’s layered, industrial districts to life, all while staying true to the spirit of the original game. 

• DYNAMIC COMBAT WITH STRATEGIC DEPTH -The innovative battle system combines strategic command-based gameplay with fast-paced action. Seamlessly switch between characters, harness the power of materia, summon iconic creatures, and unleash devastating limit breaks. 

• ICONIC CHARACTERS, UNFORGETTABLE STORY - Follow Cloud Strife, an ex-SOLDIER turned mercenary, as he joins Avalanche to take on the Shinra Electric Power Company. Cloud and his allies Barret, Tifa, and Aerith are pulled into a battle that will decide the fate of the planet. 

• EXPANDED CONTENT - FINAL FANTASY VII REMAKE INTERGRADE offers quests, mini-games, and missions set in expanded areas of Midgar. Encounter new characters and experience exciting content that adds even more depth to the story. 

• ICONIC SOUNDTRACK - The epic soundtrack has been fully remastered, with re-arranged and orchestrated tracks that dynamically respond to the action, offering an immersive, emotionally charged musical experience. 

• In-Game Bonus Content*: Weapon – Cacstar***, Summoning Materias – Carbuncle, Chocobo Chick, Cactuar, Accessories – Superstar Belt, Seraphic Earrings, Mako Crystal, Armors – Midgar Bangle, Corneo Armlet, Shinra Bangle. **The weapon “Cacstar” can only be used in FF7R EPISODE INTERmission (Yuffie episode). *The additional weapons, armor, accessories and summoning materia can be obtained from the Gift Box accessible via the main menu. 

• GAME-KEY CARD. 90 GB - Full game download via internet required.

igeek-18935gn.description:
An epic adventure across the land and skies of Hyrule awaits

 
 

 
 In this sequel to The Legend of Zelda: Breath of the Wild, you’ll decide your own path through the sprawling landscapes of Hyrule and the mysterious islands floating in the vast skies above.

 
 
 
 

 
 
 Explore. Create. Discover.

 
 
 

 
 The sky

 
 Use Link’s new abilities to explore the sky islands that have mysteriously appeared in the skies above Hyrule.

 
 

 
 The surface

 
 The sky isn’t the only thing that’s changed in Hyrule. Familiar locations have been dramatically transformed, with new towns, dank caves, and mysterious gaping chasms springing up across the world—all waiting to be explored.

 
 
 Harness the power of Link’s new abilities

 
 
 

 
 Ultrahand

 
 Using the new Ultrahand ability, Link can pick up, move, and rotate almost any object, and can even attach objects together to create bridges, vehicles, and more!

 
 

 
 Fuse

 
 Magically fuse almost any object to Link’s current weapon, shield, or arrow to increase durability, damage, or even add a new effect. Experiment with lots of different combinations to come up with surprising—and sometimes hilarious—results!

 
 
 
 
 

 
 Ascend

 
 Add a new dimension to your exploration with Ascend, which gives Link the ability to pass through solid objects above him. Rise up through ceilings, hillsides, and even certain enemies to create seemingly impossible shortcuts.

 
 

 
 Recall

 
 Use Recall to make objects in motion move backward through time, letting Link ride fallen boulders skyward, recover thrown weapons, or send projectiles back where they came from.

 
 
 
 

 
 Can you harness the power of Link’s new abilities to fight back against the malevolent forces that threaten the kingdom?
